arabic: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُعَدُّ لَهُ فِي الْمَجْلِسِ الْوَاحِدِ مِائَةُ مَرَّةٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقُومَ: رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الْغَفُورُ.
transliteration: Rabbighfir lee wa tub 'alayya, innaka antat-tawwaabul-ghafoor.
translation: Ibn Umar said: It would be counted that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) would say one hundred times at any one gathering before getting up: 'O my Lord, forgive me and turn towards me (in forgiveness). You are the Oft-Returning, the Most Forgiving.'
